title: Transfer - SMT AOI Defect Remark Normalization
goal: Normalize SMT AOI and rework-bench free-text defect remarks into a soldering and placement defect codebook, including mixed Chinese-English shorthand, duplicated causes, component references, and process-stage restrictions.
skillBenefitRationale: This transfers the same core skill to AOI/rework data: messy technician defect notes still require segmentation, semantic codebook matching, component-aware reasoning, and calibrated UNKNOWN handling without needing any other shipped skill.
